name: Hajimari wa Owari to Tomo ni... Beginning is the End...
original_name: 始まりは終わりとともに… Beginning is the End…
source:
Miki Tachikawa spends happy days with her lover Kazuhiko Kuniyama. But one day girl Mirai comes down from the sky. Her landing creates a crater, but she stays unharmed herself. Mirai comes to break this world!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
